lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.quote: > Do not say that Section $4$ makes all eight norms a blanket rule for every moment of private life.
lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.note: The rewrite now includes a populated Traps to Watch For section, which is the required General Information addition.

lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.quote: Do public work with skill, care, and dedication. Officials should also avoid making public service look like a source of special favors.
lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.note: The original statutory sentence was replaced with short plain-language teaching. A separate L02 finding remains elsewhere.

lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.quote: These are standards for public officials and employees while they carry out official duties.
lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.note: The rewrite now states the Section 4 official-duty setting instead of saying all eight norms apply at all times.

lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.quote: Republic Act No. $6713$ is the **Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees**. It was approved on February $20$, $1989$ and took effect on March $25$, $1989$.
lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.note: The statute number and all date numerals in the cited passage are now wrapped in inline math.

lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.quote: How many norms of conduct are listed in Section $4$ of RA $6713$?
lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.note: The count is now asked directly as an exam-style question without the old review-question meta framing.

lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.quote: **Public accountability** means officials must answer to the people for how they use public power and resources.
lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.note: The previously unexplained public-accountability term now has a plain definition before the related example.

lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.quote: Section $4$ gives eight norms of conduct. These are standards for public officials and employees while they carry out official duties.
lesson-code-of-conduct-ra-6713-norms-of-.note: The governing applicability condition is now taught explicitly as conduct while carrying out official duties.

general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.quote: It was approved on February $20$, $1989$ and took effect on March $25$, $1989$.
general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.note: The approval and effectivity dates are taught directly as orientation facts, without inventing a date calculation.

general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.quote: The key facts are unfair discrimination and the applicant's rights.
general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.note: Example 4 now requires matching an improper denial of lawful service to the norm protecting fair treatment and rights.

general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.quote: Responsiveness also covers prompt and adequate service, openness of information when allowed, consultation when appropriate, suggestions, simpler procedures, and avoiding red tape.
general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.note: The rewrite now teaches transparency, consultation, suggestions, procedure simplification, and red-tape avoidance.

general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.quote: Support locally produced goods, resources, and technology, build pride in the country, and help defend Philippine sovereignty from foreign intrusion.

general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.quote: Be loyal to the Republic and the Filipino people. Support locally produced goods, resources, and technology, build pride in the country, and help defend Philippine sovereignty from foreign intrusion.
general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.note: The rewrite now connects loyalty to the Republic and Filipino people with the local-resource and sovereignty duties requested.

general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.quote: The norms do not all describe the same kind of conduct. On an exam, focus on the action in the situation and match it to the norm that most directly covers that action.

general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.quote: Section $6$ creates an annual system of incentives and rewards for outstanding public officials and employees.
general-information-code-of-conduct-ra-6.note: The rewrite now teaches the Section 6 incentive system and adds a worked example asking which part of the law provides it.
